failures.symptom: Passing standard Arabic/Uthmani text to the tokenizer causes an immediate crash or maps all inputs to '[UNK]' (unknown) tokens because the vocabulary contains only Latin graphemes ('a', 'b', 't', 'th', 'j', 'h', etc.).
failures.remedy: To use Model C, a Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) translation layer must be constructed to convert standard Arabic Quran text into the specific phonetic Latin representation used by the Buraaq training dataset.
